title: Open Source: The connective tissue of Open Science
content:
Research software shouldn't expire when a grant ends. Sayeed Choudhury on how Carnegie Mellon’s OSPO is building the 'connective tissue' to turn lab code into lasting community products.

The post Open Source: The connective tissue of Open Science appeared first on Software Heritage.
